title: Cancer Free Since 2006
content: Cancer Free Since 2006Radical Remission ProjectDec 22, 20231 min readOn the morning of February 2, 2006, after four heart-wrenching years with lymphoma, Anita Moorjani's body had finally had enough and she went into a coma. Her family was told by her doctors that she wouldn’t make it through the night.About thirty hours after she entered the coma, her eyes started to flicker open. Once she regained consciousness, inexplicably to her doctors, her cancer began to heal rapidly. To their amazement, she was free of countless tumors and cancer indicators within weeks.Since then, Anita has heeded the call to share her powerful story - and divine lessons - with the world: “Love yourself fully. That’s your purpose. That’s what you’re here to do.”Listen to Anita's story and others like it here!335335 views00 commentsPost not marked as liked
